messages:
Maya: morning async — quick update from kernel side: landed a microbatching tweak in canary, saw ~12% p95 improvement on our short-sequence bench. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4567
Jon: nice. what's the canary tag? any regressions?
Maya: tag is `canary/mbatch-v2`. No regressions in smoke tests but hit one OOM on a 32k-seq run (repro below).
Maya: ```
RuntimeError: OOM allocating KV cache
  at src/runtime/kv_cache.cpp:412
  alloc requested: 512MB, free: 48MB
Command: ./bench --seq 32000 --concurrency 8
```
Li: ack — I'll take that. sounds like prefetch caused a spike. which flag controlled it?
Maya: it was `kv_prefetch=true`. I flipped it to `false` and restarted the canary hosts ~10m ago. also bumped kv cap for shard-3 from 1.2GB -> 1.6GB as a temporary mitigation.
Sam: can you paste p50/p95/p99 and bench cfg? ops-bot, any deploy note?
ops-bot: Deploy event: canary/mbatch-v2 deployed to 4 hosts (4/4). CI: :white_check_mark: all green.
Maya: perf numbers (short-seq bench): p50 62ms -> 54ms, p95 420ms -> 370ms, p99 980ms -> 910ms. bench cfg: prefix=64 tokens, batcher_slot=16, quant-kernels=yes.
Jon: solid. @Sam can you run a small A/B against real traffic patterns? https://bench.redwood/quick-eval
Sam: kicked off 50k-query ramp now, watching p95 and tail. will drop summary here by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Li: filed issue for OOM + metric request: https://issues.redwood/1234 — adding `kv_alloc_peak` and a regression test for 32k seq. assigning to @Li.
Maya: blockers: need CR approvals on PR #4567 and a thumbs on the prod kv-cap bump before I roll the cap change wider. @Jon @Sam
Jon: on it, reviewing now. expect comments within a few hours.
Sam: :thumbsup: small doc nit in the config section, will approve after that fix.
Maya: thanks — plan for today: iterate on OOM root cause (Li + me), follow AB results (Sam), land PR if reviews clear, and push safe rollout for kv cap if no regressions. ping here for any spikes or odd errors.
